source: Tiled floors for the Blender scene, each made by scripts/make_floor_tiles.py from photographs of the tile's faces: a seamless grid with grout, each tile a face at random, and a bump map from the faces' detail.
notes: The pictures stay on this Mac in ~/Library/Application Support/CabinetStudio/decors as <name>.jpg / .png: colour, height (16-bit) and grout mask. Roughness and bump are our visual estimates, not supplier figures.

source.faces: 10 face photographs from the product page, supplied by the owner
